name: Map
line: Where people find you online, and how they book or buy.
question: Can people find you, and can they get in?
what: Your website, search and AI visibility, plus the front door where people book or buy.
wrong: Search, maps and AI assistants send people to a competitor, or the site looks right and never books.
make: Booking, checkout and ordering entry points
check: Accessibility under Ontario's AODA and WCAG 2.2 AA
Privacy under PIPEDA, and PHIPA wherever health information is involved
quiz: When someone asks Google or an AI assistant for what you do nearby, do you come up?
